legalMaskEncoding: 59 lowercase hex digits; action i is bit i%4 of digit floor(i/4)

sourceProvenance.createdAt: UTC ISO-8601 milliseconds generated at collection
sourceProvenance.initialSeed: positive JavaScript-safe integer; one-based episode n uses initialSeed + n - 1
sourceProvenance.environmentDecisions: exact full simulator card-play decision count including all seats; learner-only samples provide a checked lower bound

environment.learnerSeats: approximately half; only behavior-model decisions are samples

observation.privacy: own private hand plus public state only; opponent hands excluded

sample.terminal: last card-play decision by that actor in that act
sample.finishPlace: final one-based finish order in that act
sample.forced: true exactly when legalActionIndices has length one

summary.environmentDecisions: source-declared full-decision count, bounded by sampled step indices and maximumTransitionsPerAct
summary.opponentSeatAssignments: exact configured non-learner seat total across episodes

strictBindings: observation schema and observation-derived legal actions
exact action catalogue and action features
recomputed behavior log probability and value
exact game, house rules, non-card policy, league policy, and reward semantics
canonical sample provenance, observation fields, trajectories, and finish places
reward recomputed from terminal, finishPlace, and playerCount
environment, episode, learner, forced, policy, and opponent-assignment counts
all loaded and computed arrays are finite
regular non-symlink rollout source paths, byte lengths, and SHA-256 remain stable across validation and behavior binding
